inputs.root_cause: SAL-NRRD-OBL-C13492B6879B6E90 (NRRD-HEADER-001) requires the pinned spec's explicit ordinary-field grammar: 'a colon followed by a single space' and 'whitespace ... is not allowed before a field identifier' (SAL-NRRD-00008, confirmed word-for-word against the pinned src-nrrd-001.bin spec source). reader.py's ordinary-field branch unconditionally stripped both key and value, silently accepting leading whitespace before the identifier, a missing space after the colon, or multiple spaces after the colon -- all spec violations.
inputs.acceptance_evidence: reader.py._parse_header now rejects (a) any line with leading whitespace before an ordinary field identifier and (b) a colon not followed by exactly one space, both with dedicated NrrdParseError messages. 6 new tests in test_obligation_header_field_grammar.py prove: single-space-after-colon parses; trailing value whitespace remains correctly ignored (spec explicitly permits this, unaffected by the new checks); and 4 parametrized grammar violations (leading space, leading tab, no space after colon, two spaces after colon) are each rejected.
inputs.regression_tier: full nrrd package suite (tests/python/nrrd) plus 6-format regression

execution_steps: 1. Read the pinned spec source directly (.local/format-contracts/acquired/nrrd/src-nrrd-001.bin, SRC-NRRD-001) rather than trusting the obligation's paraphrase: confirmed verbatim 'a colon followed by a single space ... and then the [field descriptor]', 'Whitespace (that is not part of the previous line's termination) is not allowed before a field identifier', and 'Extra whitespace after the field descriptor and before the line termination is ignored' -- the last clause meaning trailing value whitespace must stay permissive.

2. Read reader.py's _parse_header ordinary-field branch (lines 109-117 before this slice): key.strip() and value.strip() both silently absorbed leading-key whitespace and any colon-spacing variant, contradicting the confirmed spec text.

3. Checked no existing test fixture across tests/python/nrrd relies on non-conformant spacing (grepped for header field lines without a single space after the colon) -- none found, all hand-built fixtures already use 'field: value'.

4. Added two explicit checks before the existing malformed/duplicate checks: reject line[0].isspace(), and reject a colon not immediately followed by exactly one space. Verified interactively against 4 hostile cases plus 2 valid cases before writing any test.
5. Wrote 6 new tests in a new file (2 positive, 4 negative parametrized) proving the exact grammar boundary, including that trailing whitespace remains ignored per the spec's own permissive clause.

6. Ran ruff (clean) and the full nrrd suite (490 passed, was 484, +6) before writing any evidence claim. Ran the full 6-format regression (2961 passed, was 2955, +6; same 4 pre-existing unrelated safetensors interop failures, 2 skipped) confirming zero cross-format regression.
tests_run: .venv/Scripts/pytest tests/python/ipynb tests/python/ora tests/python/nrrd tests/python/xliff tests/python/safetensors tests/python/ubl -q -- 2961 passed, 2 skipped, 4 preexisting unrelated safetensors interop failures, was 2955 passed
